whatsNew.title: Getting-started tour and note labels
items: New getting-started tour with real screenshots. Pick Everyday use or Owner / admin and step through the screens. Replay it from ⋮ › Getting started tour.
Notes can have labels, like Work or Travel. Tap a label at the top of Notes to see only those notes.
The guide under ⋮ › Help & guide now refreshes its screenshots automatically whenever the app changes.
